articles.title: Bitcoin steadies around $77,000 after volatile three-week correction; easing US-Iran tensions lift sentiment
articles.content: Bitcoin traded near the $77,000 mark after recovering from a volatile correction phase as easing U.S.-Iran tensions improved investor sentiment. While Ethereum and select altcoins remained under pressure, broader crypto market sentiment stabilised amid hopes of geopolitical de-escalation, although analysts continued to warn about leverage-driven volatility and short-term resistance levels.

articles.title: RBI dividend provides fiscal buffer, but inflation risks loom large: Kanika Pasricha, Union Bank
articles.content: The Reserve Bank of India's dividend payout provides a small fiscal buffer. However, government finances face pressure from fuel excise cuts and rising fertiliser subsidies. Inflation risks are increasing due to higher fuel prices. This situation suggests a cautious approach to monetary policy as the central bank monitors economic indicators.

articles.title: Aluminium prices near record high: What’s driving the rally?
articles.content: Aluminium prices are trading near multi-year highs due to persistent structural supply tightness, not temporary factors. Stricter environmental rules, high energy costs, and production caps are limiting output, while low global inventories further tighten supply and support elevated prices.

articles.content: JM Financial Asset Management has launched its second performing credit Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) to tap into the fast-growing private credit market in India and rising demand for structured credit investments. articles.title: Global equity flows chasing momentum, not value: Anurag Singh

Capital allocation is increasingly momentum-driven, with India temporarily out of favor for global investors.

articles.title: ​A Tougher Fed? Markets brace for policy shift under Kevin Warsh
articles.content: Kevin Warsh has taken charge as the new U.S. Federal Reserve chair amid rising inflation, elevated oil prices and geopolitical tensions. Investors are closely watching whether he prioritises growth or inflation control, with markets anticipating tighter liquidity conditions, reduced policy transparency and a potentially more aggressive stance on inflation management.

articles.title: Sterlite Technologies shares rise 5% after subsidiary bags $1.1 billion hyperscaler AI contract
articles.content: Sterlite Technologies shares rose nearly 5% after its subsidiary secured a multi-year optical connectivity supply agreement worth an estimated $1.11 billion from a global hyperscaler for AI-ready data centre projects in the US. The deal, spanning FY27–FY29, strengthens STL’s position in the growing AI infrastructure space and supports hyperscale data centre deployments with advanced networking solutions.

articles.title: Arvind Panagariya on what RBI transfer of ₹2.87 lakh cr surplus to govt means for Indian economy

articles.title: Global Market: Equity funds see first weekly outflow in nine weeks amid yield surge
articles.content: Global equity funds recorded their first weekly outflow in nine weeks as rising inflation concerns and surging borrowing costs dented investor sentiment. While U.S. and Asian equity funds saw withdrawals, technology and gold funds continued to attract inflows. Bond funds also remained in demand amid heightened geopolitical tensions and market uncertainty.
